artwork.headline: Chen holds the ARC-3 lead; NVARC3 sits just ahead of Turducken

image.alt: NVARC3’s four established characters build a huge GPU juggernaut, with Chen’s two rabbits beside Tufa’s spider banner on a distant snowy peak. A separate footer preserves the morning leaders: Chen 75.56; Tufa 70.24.
image.caption: Existing newspaper illustration; new edition score panel: Nov 1, 2026 · 5:30 AM EST; provisional public standings.

artworkReuse: Existing approved native illustration, not a new generation; newly composed with this edition’s preserved morning scores.

originalSections.heading: Chen keeps room at the front
originalSections.text:
Yi-Chia Chen @ Fields Model leads ARC-3 on 75.56 at Sunday’s morning cutoff, with Tufa Labs second on 70.24. The 5.32-point gap leaves a very different chase from ARC-2’s sub-point contest between the same two names. Chen’s score is unchanged against the midnight baseline.

faster machine is all you need remains third on 58.59. Behind that podium, NVARC3 stands fourth on 56.15, just 0.13 ahead of Team Turducken on 56.02. The morning evidence establishes that order; missing baseline comparisons for NVARC3 and Tufa do not establish the size or timing of an overnight gain.

originalSections.heading: A crowded chase behind fourth
originalSections.text:
the last dance is sixth on 51.51, followed by yktori on 51.04, Grigoriy Zatravkin & co on 50.48 and mtg on 50.37. Only 0.11 separates eighth and ninth. Turducken, the last dance, yktori and mtg have unchanged scores against the midnight baseline even where their ranks have slipped.

Team Alicia supplies a measured overnight advance farther down the board: 0.35 points to 36.89, moving from 44th to 40th. The lead remains Chen’s; the narrow gaps in the chase show where a subsequent scored improvement could matter most.

originalSections.heading: A fixed morning picture
originalSections.text: This delayed Early edition uses the scheduled morning cutoff, not the newer results arriving later on Sunday. Public social and discussion reporting was not refreshed for this issue. The reserved team profiles remain held for a later edition, with their identities, dates and release conditions intact.
